summary.headline: China calls for AI cooperation with the US ahead of APEC
summary.body: A quiet Sunday. China called for AI cooperation with the US ahead of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, lifting Global Coordination by 0.22. The US disrupted North Korea's 'FaceStealer' deepfake-call scheme, tied to more than $400 million in crypto theft, nudging Catastrophic Risk up. OpenAI credited GPT-6 Astra with a proof step toward a lattice definition of the Standard Model. Gatekeeper and 1984 rose slightly. Horizon Balance slipped to -10.86 from -10.82.
summary.movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.1, from China's cooperation call (+0.17) and Astra's physics proof step (+0.02), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.07). 1984 +0.1, mostly from China's cooperation call (+0.10) and fading earlier news (+0.03). Descendants -0.08, from fading earlier news (-0.11), partly offset by Astra's physics proof step (+0.03).

events.title: China calls for AI cooperation with US ahead of Shenzhen APEC summit
events.summary: Beijing publicly called for AI cooperation with Washington ahead of the APEC leaders' week in Shenzhen, where Trump and Xi are due to meet.
events.reason: Diplomatic words favouring US-China AI cooperation; signal only, T1.

events.title: US disrupts North Korean 'FaceStealer' deepfake-call scheme tied to $400M+ crypto theft
events.summary: The US Justice Department disrupted a North Korean campaign that used deepfake video calls to compromise targets, linked to over $400M in cryptocurrency theft.
events.reason: Reveals the scale of state-backed AI-enabled (deepfake) cyber theft, raising catastrophic/cyber risk despite the takedown; T1.

events.title: OpenAI credits GPT-6 Astra with proof step toward defining lattice Standard Model
events.summary: An OpenAI science post says GPT-6 Astra produced a proof related to a lattice definition of the Standard Model of particle physics.
events.reason: Another self-reported AI science result following earlier OpenAI math claims; unverified externally, so T1.
